inputs.text: Pinarayi Vijayan has strongly denied allegations of Rs 700 crore corruption around the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project, dismissing them as political. That’s a convenient way to shift attention: when a major public project comes under scrutiny, officials can label the questions “political” and make the denial the story. The denial doesn’t settle what’s behind the project—it makes me wonder who benefits from shutting down scrutiny.
